lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a non-uniform geometric grid across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a grid-like topology where the blobs serve as nodal points of maximum intensity.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient—characterized by high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries—traverse the upper and mid-lateral flank toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 8 to 10 discrete, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily within the posterior and distal regions of the fin's surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, blue-pigmented artificial tag is attached to the upper posterior margin of the first dorsal fin. A remora is visible as a secondary biological silhouette beneath the ventral midsection.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density and smaller average diameter of high-luminance spots compared to the more widely spaced, larger blobs on the mid-lateral flank.
